generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's vine species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 47 Araliaceae: mostly woody, some climbing by aerial roots (ivy); leaves alternate, rarely opposite; stipules joined to the leaf stalk's base or within it, rarely absent; flowers regular, in umbels, racemes or heads; calyx small on an inferior ovary; petals often 5; fruit a berry or drupe.

traits.rosette.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Araliaceae: whether the leaves gather in rosettes (character 22), coded no rosette. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 21 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.

traits.life_span.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Araliaceae: the herbs' life form (character 21), coded perennial. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 21 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
